text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Racewear—they are dreams made
manifest, a racer's constant
companion,
and a symbol of admiration for many.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the cool touch of the early summer
breeze, Umamusume gear
up to partake in
a competition to acquire a unique set of
racewear.

Hehe. ♪ I'm glad to see such a large
gathering of très bien diamonds
in the
rough this year too!

Which of you lovelies will have the honor
of adorning yourself in my
wedding
dress-inspired racewear, I wonder?

Now! Without further ado, let us
commence the Beauty Dream Cup
model
audition! Show me your brilliance! ☆

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: What?! I didn't hear anything about this!

text_block_list.name: Participant B
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best... This is my chance to
get a set of racewear all
my own!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Awww, I wish I could go to Paris!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Me, too! ♪ I'd love to sample all the
delicious treats there, like the
cakes and
macarons!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Desserts are great and all... But I'm more
interested in the races!
Wouldn't you guys
like to enter the Beauty Dream Cup?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! There isn't an Umamusume alive
who wouldn't want to run
in the race that
unveils Beauty Anshinzawa's newest
works! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All her designs are top-tier—there's no one
in the fashion capital of
Paris who hasn't
heard of her genius! They say her hands
are blessed
by the goddess of beauty!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Imagine being able to run as one of her
fashion models! The
Umamusume in Paris
are so lucky!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Guys, guys! Turn on the TV THIS
INSTANT!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Ms. Beauty, is it true that you're going to
be relocating to Japan?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Something stirred in me after hearing my sister talk about our hometown. I just know there are unpolished gems waiting for me to turn them into diamonds!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Is that why you decided to host the Beauty
Dream Cup and its
auditions in Japan
starting from this year?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Correct. ♪ The entry requirements are the
same as they were in Paris.
As long as they
spark my interest, anyone can enter
regardless of their
accomplishments or
debut status. ☆

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And now for a message to the Umamusume
beauties of Japan—I can't
wait to see your
gorgeous faces at the auditions! I'll be
waitiiing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement! This is regarding the
URA-authorized Beauty Dream
Cup event
usually held in Paris each year!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Henceforth, the event will be held in
Japan, following the relocation
of the
event organizer, Beauty Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the audition to decide the
muses and models for her
outfits will also
be held in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA would like to encourage students
to participate and further
their growth as
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I, too, hope you will all take this chance to
expand your horizons!
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't expecting this to become such a
big deal... Are you two going
to enter the
audition?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After all, the concept for Beauty
Anshinzawa's racewear design
is bridal
wear!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can make a grown-up lady shine
brighter than a wedding
dress! I've just
gotta get my hands on an outfit like that!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Me too! As one who aspires to become a
princess with both beauty
and strength, I
can't miss the chance to get such a dress
and become
a muse!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I happen to run into a prince in
the future, it'll be much
easier to catch him
if I get used to running in a dress now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You two sure are fired up for this.
I'll have to give it my all
too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It would be so buono if we could all run in
wedding dresses
together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The Beauty Dream Cup...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(If I become a muse, maybe it'll help me
gain a little more confidence
in myself...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps then I'll be able to run even when
there are a lot of people
watching me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Dober? Are you
thinking about the audition?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove... Yes... I just can't muster up
the courage to enter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel I'm not worthy of
being called an "Umamusume
beauty."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. But beauty is in the eye of the
beholder, is it not? Rather than
worrying
so much, why not simply apply and let the
designer decide?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Logically speaking, I know
that's the best thing to do,
but I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you don't believe in yourself, then believe in me. At the very least, I think you're an Umamusume deserving of recognition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Gracious. The whole school is in an uproar
over this audition.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? It's Mother...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Air Groove! I saw Beauty
Anshinzawa's press conference!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you'll be applying for the
audition, right? I'll be your
biggest
cheerleader!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this makes me think of when you were
younger. Do you remember
what you said
when you saw me in my racewear?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted to be just like me,
and that when you grew up,
you were
going to get a first-rate designer to create
your very own
racewear!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Beauty Anshinzawa was an
apprentice of the great
designer who
created my outfit, you know! Oh, this must
be
destiny! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She sounded so delighted, there was no
way I could tell her I wasn't
planning to
audition...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I become a muse, my popularity will rise
and bring me closer to my
goal of
becoming the Empress... I just have to tell
myself that's what
it's for...
